name: Fate's Hand — Major Arcana (EN)

attribution.text: Original Fate's Hand content: all rights reserved. This layer adds records of its own and modifies NO material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 — the twenty-two Major Arcana exist in no SRD, and nothing here patches, extends or reproduces SRD text.

description: The twenty-two Major Arcana of Fate's Hand, in the canonical order of the deck (0 to XXI). Each card carries its Destiny impact — 5 cards at 0, 9 at 1, 8 at 2 — plus its meaning, its power and its vibration. The impact is a term of the Destiny Score; the three texts are read at the table.

data.name: The Fool
data.meaning: innocence, beginnings, carefreeness, freedom. Unlimited potential, stepping into the unknown without fear. Exploration without attachments, trust in chance.
data.power: once per long rest, roll 2 Destiny dice at once, take the total of both as a bonus, and pay only the price of the highest.
data.vibration: luck effect (Bless or Guidance depending on level).

data.name: The Magician
data.meaning: ingenuity, creativity, mastery of tools. The intellect shapes reality. The initiator of change through willpower.
data.power: once per long rest, adjust the size of a Destiny die of a willing creature (d4 into d12 or vice-versa).

data.name: The High Priestess
data.meaning: hidden knowledge, intuition, mystery. Inner wisdom, revelation through patient study. Silence and secrets of the soul.
data.power: roll a Destiny die in secret and store it; you may use the result before the end of the next long rest.
data.vibration: divination effect (Detect Evil and Good, Augury).

data.name: The Empress
data.meaning: fertility, abundance, growth, prosperity. Support, harmony, generosity.
data.power: recover an additional Destiny Point after a long rest if you have 2 or less.

data.name: The Emperor
data.meaning: authority, order, stable power. Construction, organization, protection.
data.power: once per long rest, sacrifice a die to obtain the highest possible bonus non-critical result.
data.vibration: defensive effect (Mage Armor, Shield minor effect).

data.name: The Hierophant
data.meaning: tradition, teaching, spiritual guidance. Faith, rituals, sacred order.
data.power: once per short rest, as a reaction within 30 feet, convert one of your Destiny dice into healing and add it to one individual short-rest dice (+ Constitution bonus), with no cost in Destiny Points.
data.vibration: sacred blessing (Bless, Protection from Evil and Good).

data.name: The Lovers
data.meaning: choice, harmony, relationships, moral dilemmas. Union, sacrifice, cooperation.
data.power: once per long rest, as a reaction, roll a Destiny die to the benefit of one party member within 30 ft of you, while another (including you) suffers the cost.

data.name: The Chariot
data.meaning: victory, determination, triumph. Active control, moving toward success.
data.power: once per long rest, you have advantage on a Destiny die. Choose either the lowest or the highest.

data.name: Strength
data.meaning: courage, mastery of instincts, perseverance, moral and physical endurance.
data.power: the critical range of your Destiny dice is doubled (3 or 4 on a d4, 5 or 6 on a d6).

data.name: The Hermit
data.meaning: introspection, solitude, search for truth. Knowledge found in inner calm.
data.power: once per long rest, store the result of your lowest available Destiny die and use it later.

data.name: Wheel of Fortune
data.meaning: change, unstable destiny, opportunity, unpredictability. Embracing the cycle of ups and downs.
data.power: on the first Destiny roll of the day choose advantage or disadvantage, then a cycle is in place. That same day, any individual (including you) within 30 ft rolling a Destiny die rolls with advantage if you chose disadvantage, or the contrary.
data.vibration: random yet beneficial effect (e.g. advantage on the next roll).

data.name: Justice
data.meaning: fairness, responsibility, moral order. Evaluating, assuming responsibility, restoring balance.
data.power: after a long rest, transfer up to 2 Destiny Points and 2 Destiny dice from the strongest to the weakest. Recipients may be willing or not. You may freely rule on ties. Up to 4 individuals.

data.name: The Hanged Man
data.meaning: sacrifice, letting go, new perspective. Renouncing to gain understanding.
data.power: if you invoke Chaos on a natural 1, you do not lose but immediately regain 2 Destiny Points and just roll 1d6 on the Chaos table.

data.name: Death
data.meaning: transformation, end of a cycle, rebirth. Radical change, not absolute finality.
data.power: you are immune to everything above 6 on the Chaos table, and trigger an Awakening on a 12.
data.vibration: survival / minor necromancy effect (e.g. False Life).

data.name: Temperance
data.meaning: moderation, harmony, compromise. Finding balance and the right measure.
data.power: once per long rest, in a 30 ft radius, as a reaction roll a Destiny die that acts as a buffer limiting the Destiny cost.

data.name: The Devil
data.meaning: temptation, illusions, voluntary servitude. Power at the cost of freedom.
data.power: once per short rest, roll a Destiny die in advance if you have one, and give it to anyone within 30 ft. It costs the recipient one Destiny Point; you collect this as a temporary Destiny Point, and your die is blocked until they use it or their next long rest ends. When used it acts as their own; your die then resets. An infernal Awakening may have strange consequences.

data.name: The Tower
data.meaning: shock, collapse, brutal revelation. Destruction to rebuild on truth.
data.power: once per long rest, as a reaction, sacrifice all your Destiny Points to transform any successful roll into a critical failure within 30 ft. Ignore the Chaos Effect.

data.name: The Star
data.meaning: hope, inspiration, celestial guidance. A beacon in the night, trust in the future.
data.power: once per long rest, take the average (rounded up) of a Destiny die instead of rolling.
data.vibration: minor inspiration / healing (e.g. Healing Word, Guidance).

data.name: The Moon
data.meaning: illusions, dreams, nocturnal mysteries. The unconscious mind, distorted perception.
data.power: except for a critical Fail / Success, the Destiny cost is reduced by 1.

data.name: The Sun
data.meaning: success, vitality, clarity, joy. Dispels shadows, brings optimism and truth.
data.power: once per short rest, add +2 to the result of a Destiny die without any additional cost.
data.vibration: minor light and healing (e.g. Light + small heal).

data.name: Judgement
data.meaning: rebirth, higher calling, final reckoning. Weighing the past, offering redemption or judgment.
data.power: once per short rest, spend a Destiny die with no cost in Destiny Points to replace any d20 roll by a 10.

data.name: The World
data.meaning: accomplishment, wholeness, unity. The end of one cycle, opening to a new beginning.
data.power: after a long rest, restore one Destiny Point to group members excluding yourself. Roll a die: 1d4 for 1-4 people, 1d6 for 5-6, 1d8 for 7-8, 1d10 for 9-10, 1d12 for 11-12. You pay the price rolled.
